correctness.rationale: For every uniform mapping, removing a prescribed set of r zero-indegree vertices leaves an independent uniform mapping on the other n-r vertices; cyclic points cannot belong to the deleted set. Combining this deletion identity with the exact rooted-forest k n^(n-k-1) count gives E[binom(Z,r)|C=k]=binom(n-k,r)(1-r/n)^(n-k-1), exact conditional empty-box occupancy, and strict descending conditional mean. For k=O(sqrt n), coupling conditional occupancy with n throws in n boxes controls the L2 difference as O(sqrt n) versus scale n. The classical occupancy CLT plus Rayleigh cyclic-core distribution yields asymptotic independence. Independent literal enumeration of all maps n<=6 matches the conditional moments. Boundary k=n gives Z=0. Thus the mathematical statement is correct, but C does not establish novelty.
